snippet.title: Shopping Online Is About To Change Forever
snippet.description:

One leader in the agentic commerce space is called @glanceinspires and I used it to match me with new clothing pieces based on my style, hair color, skin tone, body shape, even the weather. 

But this is way bigger than just fashion. I can see this being used for travel, home decor, cars, tech… basically all of e-commerce is going to be shifting in this direction. 

And I’m all about using AI to make everyday tasks like shopping easier. 

So if you’re on the same boat, check out what Glance is building at the link in the comments.

snippet.title: 9 Free AI Skills That Feel Like Cheat Codes
snippet.description:
9 free skills and plug-ins that make Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding agents dramatically more useful, and yes, all of them are free.
Skills and plug-ins are reusable instruction files that give your AI agent a repeatable behavior instead of starting from scratch every time. In this video I break down 9 of my favorites, install them live, and put several of them head to head so you can see exactly what changes.

I cover GStack (turns Claude Code into a full virtual engineering team), Stop Slop (strips AI tells out of your writing), Graphify (turns any codebase or knowledge base into a queryable graph your agent can use as memory), Understand Anything (visual onboarding maps for any codebase), Last 30 Days (real time sentiment research across Reddit, X, YouTube, and more), Anthropic's Front End Design skill and the Taste skill (head to head design tests), and ReMotion vs HyperFrames (AI generated animations from a single prompt).

snippet.title: Biohacking:The men trying to supercharge their sperm count - BBC World Service
snippet.description:
.When you think of fertility, you might automatically think of women’s fertility. But there are men online doing something called ‘fertilitymaxxing’ - it’s all about young men trying a bunch of unproven hacks in hopes of improving their sperm health. 

Click here to subscribe to our channel 👉🏽 https://bbc.in/3VyyriM

Content with these hacks are often pushed by male wellness and manosphere influencers online - but is this really about raising more awareness of male fertility (which is an under-researched issue)? Or is it about other anxieties Gen Z men might have about their health - and masculinity more generally?

Jacqui Wakefield is our Global Health Correspondent and has been speaking to men, like Simon in Miami, who have been doing things like icing his testicles in a bid to boost sperm count. snippet.title: WTF is China building now 😂
snippet.description:
The future is here, and it’s ready to take your crap 😂

This is a self driving toilet called Xiaoban made by Chinese company Yueban that just debuted at a Shanghai aged-care expo.

You just summon it to your bedside and it has a built-in bidet. When you’re done, it autonomously drives to your regular bathroom, dumps the waste into the toilet, scrubs its own bowl, and docks itself to recharge and refill.

Obviously this was made for folks with mobility issues, and it’s pretty cool that tech has come this far to be able to help people in this way! 

At the same time, I can’t help but imagine some people using this just for fun or out of laziness.

#AI #Robotics #FutureTech
